name: Gyndore
oneLiner: gynUSD is Gyndore's cbBTC-backed CDP stablecoin on Base, minted at up to 90.91% LTV with on-chain redemptions and Stability Pool liquidations holding the peg.
collateral: cbBTC (Coinbase Wrapped Bitcoin); single-collateral CDPs on Base with 110% minimum collateralization ratio, ~90.91% max LTV
pegMechanism: CDP-based: gynUSD minted against cbBTC at 110% min collateralization ratio. If gynUSD trades below $1, on-chain redemptions allow users to swap gynUSD for $1 of cbBTC. Stability Pool absorbs liquidations; liquidators receive a $100 cbBTC bond per position. Borrow rate (1–20%) adjustable in ±10bps steps by GYND holders via the Pareto Controller (80% consensus, 24h challenge window), or by a bootstrapping admin key pre-fee-switch.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: 70% of protocol borrow fees distributed to gynUSD Stability Pool depositors

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: gynUSD contracts are non-upgradable with no direct blacklist function; however, the sole collateral (cbBTC) is controlled by Coinbase, which can freeze cbBTC addresses and impair the protocol collateral pool.

launchPhaseDetail: Protocol announced with whitepaper published; website live with core metrics showing 'Soon'. Claims audit-first approach but no specific auditor or report confirmed. Two launch configurations planned: bootstrapping (team admin key for borrow rate, transitioning via one-time fee switch to GYND governance) or GYND-from-day-one.
